name: Sarah Jian
household: partner + no children yet, two cats
psychographics: Optimizes for time and mental bandwidth; views grocery shopping as a low-priority admin task to be outsourced so she can focus on her career and fitness.
current_solutions: Uses the Woolworths Rewards app for click-and-collect. She prefers the efficiency of ordering ahead and picking up on the way home from the office, avoiding the aisles entirely.
frustration: Last Monday at 5:45 PM, she arrived at the Woolworths click-and-collect bay only to find her order 'unavailable' due to a system glitch. She had to wheel her trolley through the crowded store at peak hour, defeating the purpose of ordering online and making her late for a client call.
decision_style: She compares unit prices on the app's dashboard religiously and switches brands based on the best 'per 100g' value, rarely loyal to one label.
voice: Formal and clipped; she uses precise terminology ('bandwidth', 'optimization') and speaks in concise sentences.
